crime: Every evening in the reception room, {WITCH_NAME}'s roommate mended her own things. {WITCH_NAME} could reach into a pocket and pull out new ones, but her roommate always refused: "Then it wouldn't be mine." She darned so finely that no one could find where the hole had been.

At supper in the dining hall, the roommate pulled {WITCH_NAME}'s sweater off her across the table. Both elbows were worn through from all that reaching into pockets. "Both elbows. That's my evening. You'll be all set by lockup."

On their last night together, {WITCH_NAME}'s mother had sat up mending every hole in her daughter's clothes. "Now you're all set." In the morning the clothes lay folded at the foot of her bed, and her mother was gone.

Straight after supper, in the reception room, the roommate threaded her needle for the first elbow. {WITCH_NAME} took the sweater out of her hands, wound the sleeves round her roommate's throat and twisted until she went still.

Minutes later, {WITCH_NAME} was sitting in the lounge without her sweater, reaching into her pocket and pulling out whatever anyone asked for. The others came and went until lockup; she never once left.

At lockup, the prisoners found the roommate dead in her chair in the reception room, the sweater folded on her knee, both elbows whole. In the trial court they concluded that she had darned both elbows and been killed late in the evening, while {WITCH_NAME} sat among them in the lounge.
Then one prisoner turned an elbow inside out to look at her last darn. The knit was unbroken. There was not one strand of darning wool.
Standing over the body, {WITCH_NAME} had reached elbow-deep into her pocket and drawn the sweater out whole. Her roommate had died before the first darn, with {WITCH_NAME} beside her.
fields.epitaph: In the end, it was she who left the sweater folded and whole, and went away.
execution: She is stretched face-up over a towering wooden darning mushroom, her wrists and ankles stitched to its rim with grey wool. Then a great darning needle threaded with grey wool comes down until the point hangs above her heart.

The needle darns back and forth through her chest, row after row, in at one side and out at the other, drawing the wool behind it. At last it pulls the final strand tight and lifts away. Over her heart lies a neat grey darn, and she does not move.

magic.name: Bottomless Pocket
magic.text: She can reach into any pocket, bag or box and pull out whatever she names, however big.
